findings.title: vsftpd 2.3.4 backdoor command execution
findings.description: vsftpd 2.3.4 contains a backdoor that opens a shell on port 6200 when a username ending in ':)' is sent.
findings.remediation: Remove vsftpd 2.3.4, install a current release from a trusted source, disable FTP if unused.

findings.title: Apache Tomcat manager exposed with default credentials
findings.description: Manual pentest logged in to /manager/html with tomcat:tomcat and could deploy a WAR file.
findings.remediation: Remove the manager app or restrict it to localhost; set strong unique credentials.

findings.title: Redis server without authentication
findings.description: Redis accepts unauthenticated commands; CONFIG SET can be abused to write files.
findings.remediation: Enable requirepass/ACLs, bind to 127.0.0.1 and enable protected-mode.

findings.title: SMB signing not required
findings.description: SMB signing is not enforced, allowing NTLM relay attacks.
findings.remediation: Enforce 'Microsoft network server: Digitally sign communications (always)' via GPO.

findings.title: Microsoft Office macro execution allowed from the internet
findings.description: Group policy does not block macros in files with Mark-of-the-Web.
findings.remediation: Enable 'Block macros from running in Office files from the Internet'.
